text:
Alice Chen: Quick sync — product needs final call on pricing tiers + rate cap behavior before we lock Q3 roadmap. Can we agree launch criteria?
Sara Patel: I sketched two options in the doc: org-level quota vs per-user/per-route tiering. Org-level simpler, per-route fairer for multi-product tenants.
Marco: Customers ask for predictable burst credits and per-route limits. Enterprise contracts won't accept shared-org caps.
Priya: Finance note: revenue model prefers per-seat or per-workload add-ons. Overages need SLOs and clear billing windows.
Alice Chen: Proposed launch must-haves: pricing matrix signed, rate-limit behavior spec per-route, billing + meter tests in staging, docs + SDK examples.
Sara Patel: Add simulators for mixed traffic (chat + embeddings) and Dedicated perf guardrails.
DaveOpsBot: deploy/qa: loadtest cluster scheduled Wed 9am PT.
Kate: Design needs to show burst/remaining quota in Console. I'll post mocks by Fri.
Alice Chen: Prototype config we tried:
```
tiers:
  - name: "Starter"
    monthly_tokens: 1_000_000
    rps: 5
    burst_credits: 50_000
  - name: "Scale"
    monthly_tokens: 10_000_000
    rps: 50
    burst_credits: 500_000
billing_window: monthly
burst_refill: "30d"
```
Sara Patel: Big question: should burst_credits be org-global or per-route? Per-route prevents embeddings from draining chat quotas but complicates metering.
Marco: Per-route sells better. Customers want to allocate tokens to core products and isolate embeddings budgets.
Priya: Per-route increases metering events. Need estimate for pipeline cost and invoice cadence for small overages.
Alice Chen: Decision call: per-route burst credits + org-level monthly quotas. Call out risks?
Sara Patel: Risk: enforcement complexity, route renames causing leaks. Need canonical route IDs + mapping.
DaveOps: We'll add route-derived keys to metrics pipeline. Estimate: 2w infra + 1w QA.
Marco: Recommend grace-mode for SMB trials (soft cap month 1). Helps conversion.
Priya: Grace-mode acceptable if opt-in and capped. Suggest grace_limit = min(5% tier tokens, 100000).
Alice Chen: Launch OKRs: billing disputes <1% month1, <0.1% month3. Trial->paid conversion +3pp for new tier.
Sara Patel: Implementation checklist: rate-limiter (per-route counters + burst buckets), route registry + mapping API, meter include route_id, billing calc for overages + grace_mode, console show remaining tokens per-route, docs + SDKs.
Kate: Console idea: org view + route drilldown with timeline scrubber.
Alice Chen: Timeline: start dev next Monday. Beta by end of quarter (~6 weeks). Everyone good?
Marco: Need feature flag for pilots and pricing sheet for pilot customers.
Sara Patel: I'll PR the rate-limiter design doc today with pseudocode for token buckets and refill.
Priya: I'll send forecast scenarios for per-route vs per-org by Thu.
Kate: Posting console mocks in product folder and linking here.
Alice Chen: Final: ship with per-route burst + org monthly quotas, opt-in grace_mode, canary pilot gating. Action items: Sara (rate limiter doc + infra estimate), Dave (loadtest + metrics), Priya (forecast), Marco (pilot customers + legal), Kate (console mocks).
Marco: +1, looping legal for TOS and overage language.
Sara Patel: Noted. Will ping when PR up. :thumbsup: 
Alice Chen: Thanks all. Follow-up sync Tue 10am PT.
DaveOpsBot: Reminder: loadtest cluster Wed 9am PT.
